description: Port napoleon J16's DXVK window-proc guard into the core (Liam approved 2026-11-04: diagnosis now, fix later; the fix ships in a core tag and napoleon picks it up in a pin bump). Source: napoleon-remastered branch job/J16 (predates napoleon J12, so it is written against proxy/core, which is now core proxy/src). Mechanism: DXVK 3.1.1 ResetWindowProc leaves a DXVK -> opengl32!wglWndProc -> DXVK previous-proc cycle after a fullscreen re-entry (stack overflow on an in-game resolution change); the guard points d3d9_dxvk.dll's own GetWindowLong/SetWindowLong import slots at a guard that reports DXVK's own proc. Moves into the core: proxy/src/dxvk_wndproc.cpp (import-slot patch of the loaded backend DLL, DxvkWndProcGuard declared in runtime.h) and proxy/src/wndprocpolicy.h (the pure WndProcBook policy); the hook-up in proxy/src/backend.cpp after LoadDxvk (it holds in pass-through too, DXVK is the backend and not engine memory), where the J16 branch's else-if after the log lines binds to the wrong if and must be fixed in the port (the unknown-backend warning must not hang off the guard branch); host test proxy/tests/test_wndproc.cpp (the pure policy: cycle and foreign-layer cases, from J16's 116-line test; add it to the host test list the way test_display_guard.cpp is); the cdb dump reader proxy/tools/dump_read.py as a core tool with the header (purpose, usage, when, verb or not-a-verb) and a tools row via wsc reg add tools, game-agnostic. Config key proxy.dxvk_wndproc_fix, bool, default 1, release value 1 (on): the core registry has no config_keys rows, keys are declared by the game's adapter table, so the core supplies the key's mechanism and doc line in docs/CONSUMING.md and napoleon adds the key row, ini line and generated kKeys entry in its pin-bump job. Game-side (stays in napoleon, not in this job): the ini line, the config_keys row, and its engine_facts rows (napoleon.dxvk.wndproc_cycle, napoleon.dxvk.rehook_paths, napoleon.pc.vulkan_icds) and the run report proxy/runs/20261030_j16dumps stay as napoleon evidence. Build id: this changes DLL inputs, so a consumer re-runs the acceptance passes after the bump. needs_pc false: the PC proof is napoleon J16's fix arm (in-game resolution change no longer overflows, log names the dropped foreign layer) after the pin bump, run by napoleon. Opus: DLL, window procs. Depends on W33 (it edits backend.cpp and DllMain-adjacent init order and the proxy's DLL inputs, so both ship in one acceptance run and avoid conflicts), not on anything else.
title: DXVK window-proc guard into the core (napoleon J16 port)
